opening.argument: The trading discussion is framed as conditional market analysis, not a promise of profit. The speaker says Bitcoin would be headed toward $70k only “if Bitcoin actually holds $68k,” and describes a possible short entry if Bitcoin loses $70k. The video also presents actual range trading, including that “we had been trading this little range that formed on between 68k and 66k,” rather than claiming certain results. The WEEX promotion discloses that the video contains “affiliate partnership with Bybit, WEEX & Coinflare,” while the accompanying warning states that virtual-asset investments are high risk and may result in capital loss. That disclosure and warning frame participation as risky, without established deceptive conduct, required payment, or guaranteed returns.
